stories.title: John Summers Clock Tower to open for tours on Saturday to mark 130 years of Shotton steelworks
stories.summary: The John Summers Clock Tower at the former Shotton steelworks will open to the public on Saturday (10 October) to mark 130 years since the works opened. stories.title: UK Government letter to Uniper asks if Connah’s Quay power station plan does enough for Dee Estuary wildlife
stories.summary: The UK Government has written to Uniper asking whether its plans would make up for the saltmarsh and curlew habitat that would be lost to a new power station at Connah’s Quay.
